text:
I've fixed all six bugs, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because this session has no shell tool. Please run it to confirm. I checked each fix against its test by reading the code.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, so I changed the import to `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, and the tests and the lending-policy comment both say 5, so I set it to 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`, so I changed it to `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing Emma, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author and year are my choice, based on the search tests, which use Austen and 1815.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events, so I changed it to `[-n:] if n > 0 else []`. The `n > 0` guard keeps `recent(0)` returning an empty list.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string, so I wrapped it in `int()`.

I didn't touch the tests.
